item.title: Taco Rice Guide: Okinawa's Tex-Mex Soul Food & Where to Eat
item.description: Taco rice is Okinawa’s quintessential fusion comfort food — seasoned taco-style ground beef, shredded lettuce, tomato and cheese piled over a bowl of white rice. Born near the American military bases in the 1980s as a cheap, filling meal for hungry servicemen, it crossed over into local life and is now an Okinawan icon. Hearty, cheap and crowd-pleasing, it’s a delicious window into the island’s deep American cultural layer. This guide covers its origins, what’s in it, where to eat it and how to order.
